component.name: RIT-M Head Mouse
component.summary: Control the cursor with head movements using AR glasses

description.p: RIT-M Head Mouse turns AR glasses with a built-in motion sensor (IMU) into a hands-free pointer: a local relay reads head motion, a virtual mouse drives the cursor on Wayland and X11, and a local web UI provides a nod trainer and settings.
Works with AR glasses that expose a built-in motion sensor (IMU) over a local link. Head tracking runs entirely on your machine.
Local-only and private: relay on 127.0.0.1:52777, UI on 127.0.0.1:52778. No cloud, no telemetry.
